outputs.explanation: Panel A shows macroscopic bright-field and fluorescence photographs of whole lungs, not a quantitative plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
The bar chart of ICG mean fluorescence intensity (mean ± SD) has the individual data points for each mouse (blue and red dots) overlaid on the bars.

The Cd68 and Spp1 panels are spatial heatmap-style visualizations of per-spot expression levels (each spot already shown individually), not a bar/summary plot of averaged replicate values, so overlaid individual points are not needed; the H&E, ICG and RNAscope images are micrographs, not plots.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing a running enrichment score; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
The bar graph shows log2 fold-change values for each gene with associated p values but does not overlay any individual data points (e.g., per-spot or per-replicate values) behind these summary bars.
Panel F consists of fluorescence and IHC micrograph/photograph images of lung sections, not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.
